lines.text: Two computers. One desk. A Mac... and a PC.
And every day, the same little ritual. You copy something on one... and it's stuck there.
[sighs] So you email it to yourself. Message it to yourself. Or type it all over again... and get one letter wrong.
What if your clipboard could just... cross over?
Copy on your Mac. Paste on your PC. It's already there. And it works the other way around, too.
Connecting them takes one short code. Type it on the other computer, and they find each other. The only rule: both need to be on the same Wi-Fi network.
Everything you copy, on both computers, lands in one shared history, with no limit. Search it, star what matters, and copy it again whenever you need it.
And it never goes through the cloud. Your computers talk directly, encrypted, on your own network. Copying a password? One click pauses it all.
In English, Hebrew, Spanish, French, Russian, or Arabic.
So stop sending things to yourself. Just copy... and paste.
ClipBridge. Free and open source, for Mac and Windows.
